title: World objects (content/objects.json)
description: Things in the world players use with a right-click: gathered objects (mushrooms, herbs) give an item, chests are filled from a loot table when first opened (first come, first served). Where they stand is in each map's objects.json.

displayId.description: How it looks (the client's object displays).

item.description: The item a gathered object gives.

loot.description: A chest: the loot table (loot.json) it is filled from when someone first opens it. The table must always give money and no quest items.

respawnSeconds.description: Comes back this long after it was gathered or emptied.

questOnly.description: Only players who still need the item for a quest can gather it (and see it shine). Not used by chests.
